```{python}
#| include: false

import pickle
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "../code/python")
from run_analysis import make_length_figure
from plotnine import theme, theme_minimal

results_path = Path("../output/results.pkl")
with results_path.open("rb") as results_file:
    results = pickle.load(results_file)

annual_data = results["annual_data"]
highlights = results["highlights"]
```

## Research Question

- Do 10-K filings continue to grow longer over time?
- Replicates @DLS2017 using the EDGAR 10-K dataset
- Extends their sample period (1996–2013) to `{python} highlights["year_range"].split("–")[1]`

## Data

```{python}
#| output: asis
first_year, last_year = highlights["year_range"].split("–")
print(
    f"- EDGAR 10-K dataset (TRR266 server), accessed via DuckDB over HTTPS\n"
    f"- Filters: $\\geq$ 3,000 words, successful download, one per firm per year\n"
    f"- {highlights['sample_size']:,} firm-year observations from "
    f"{highlights['n_firms']:,} firms, {highlights['year_range']}"
)
```

## 10-K Word Count over Time

```{python}
(
    make_length_figure(annual_data)
    + theme_minimal(base_size=8)
    + theme(figure_size=(7, 3.5))
).draw()
```

## Conclusion

```{python}
#| output: asis
change = highlights["median_words_last"] - highlights["median_words_first"]
pct = round(100 * change / highlights["median_words_first"])
first_year, last_year = highlights["year_range"].split("–")
print(
    f"- Median word count: {highlights['median_words_first']:,} words ({first_year}) "
    f"$\\to$ {highlights['median_words_last']:,} words ({last_year})\n"
    f"- Increase of approximately {pct}\\%"
)
```

- The time trend of @DLS2017 continues beyond their sample period
